material.acceptance_criteria: the connection-cap job reads each refused response with one read of 12 bytes or EOF and asserts the status line is complete in every case; the job prints http status line ok refused=<n> complete=<n>.
material.description: The single-write change is witnessed by reading the code and by CI passing, but no CI check reads a refused response with one 12-byte read and asserts the full status line. Add that assertion and print the matched status line.
material.resolution: A CI job at cap 2 reads each of 8 refused responses with one recv of 12 bytes and asserts HTTP/1.1 503 in every case (printed http status line ok refused=8 complete=8). Self-witnessed by the executor; the orchestrator verifier is still to run.
material.subject: Assert the full status line on every refused response directly
